staging.ageBasis: Newest mtime_ns or ctime_ns across the root and every descendant
requiredBeforeEachBatch: Operator completes a fresh full reference audit with no unresolved reads or references and binds its SHA-256 into the plan
Operator explicitly approves each exact candidate and the SHA-256 of the complete plan bytes
All candidate writers, including non-root owners and groups, are excluded for the operation
Every candidate passes the exact metadata tree fingerprint, directory identity and mount checks before any deletion
Each candidate is revalidated immediately before deletion; mutation or failure aborts the remaining batch and reports partial progress
protectedByDefault: Player databases, state, recovery journals and keys
Current services, active public feed dependencies and all backups
Home directories, /opt, unique source material and any candidate with uncertain ownership or references

publicReleases.currentPhase: Retain every public release and every referenced dependency
futurePruneGates: Explicit operator authorization enables a separately reviewed prune implementation
All channels, manifests, signatures and transitively referenced shared objects are enumerated without read gaps
Current and at least two independently validated rollback release closures remain available
Shared artifacts are retained while any retained release or other live consumer references them

requiredBeforeConsideringAutoPrune: Coherent PostgreSQL, authoritative state and recovery, protected key material and exact release-pair identity are captured together
Off-host copies are complete and verified against recorded hashes
A documented restore using the coherent backup set has passed
An operator explicitly enables a separately reviewed policy and implementation

metadataAudit.eligibleFiles: Only JSON metadata audit files positively identified as generated by this retention tool
metadataAudit.deletionScope: Only this tool own authenticated metadata records; no game stage, release, state or backup deletion

diskAlerts.metric: Available filesystem bytes and percentage on each monitored filesystem
diskAlerts.response: Alert and require operator review; thresholds never authorize automatic deletion
diskAlerts.delivery: Private daily JSON report and local systemd journal; no external notification configured
